description: Write the migration and rollback plan document (docs/occm_groups_migration_plan.md) covering how to migrate from occm_groups to the official PR #19059 system and how to cleanly rollback the feature.
steps: Create docs/occm_groups_migration_plan.md with the following sections:
1. Overview: Purpose of this document - ensuring clean migration path to official groups and safe rollback

2. Data Mapping: Table-by-table mapping from occm_ tables to PR #19059 official tables (occm_groups -> groups, occm_group_memberships -> group_memberships, etc.). Include column-level mapping showing which occm_ columns correspond to official schema columns.

3. Migration Strategy: Step-by-step procedure for migrating data from occm_ tables to official tables when PR #19059 merges. Include: pre-migration checks, data transformation scripts, verification queries, and rollback within migration.
4. API Migration: How to redirect /api/v1/occm_groups/ endpoints to official /api/v1/groups/ endpoints. Include deprecation period strategy and client notification approach.
5. OAuth Scope Migration: How to map read:occm_groups/write:occm_groups to official read:groups/write:groups scopes.

6. Feature Rollback Plan: Complete removal procedure if groups feature needs to be disabled. Include: migration reversal (dropping occm_ tables), route removal, scope removal, frontend feature flag approach.
7. Compatibility Notes: Document known differences between occm_ implementation and PR #19059 design. Note which features may not have direct equivalents and require manual intervention.
8. Timeline Considerations: Guidance on when to trigger migration vs. maintaining parallel systems temporarily.
acceptance_criteria: docs/occm_groups_migration_plan.md exists and is well-structured markdown
Document includes table-by-table data mapping between occm_ and official schemas
Migration strategy includes pre-checks, transformation, verification steps
Rollback plan provides complete removal procedure
API endpoint migration path is documented
OAuth scope transition strategy is documented
Document references actual Mastodon migration patterns (db/migrate/ file format)
verification: Confirm docs/occm_groups_migration_plan.md exists with cat docs/occm_groups_migration_plan.md | wc -l showing substantial content (200+ lines)
Confirm migration mapping sections exist: grep -c 'occm_group' docs/occm_groups_migration_plan.md showing multiple references
Confirm rollback section exists: grep -i 'rollback' docs/occm_groups_migration_plan.md | head -5
